description: Transition-axis aliases. Most transitions reach canonical form via the expansion table (preset → tracks). This table covers the few cases where the author writes a transition without invoking a preset (e.g., a bare 'fade' shorthand or a direct track invocation).

aliases.notes: Bare 'transitions: { enter: "fade" }' string shorthand canonicalizes to the fade preset with default params. Most authors should reach for the preset form instead.
